'''Ana Maria Lajusticia''' (26 July 1924 – 7 November 2024) was a Spanish [[biochemist]] and [[nutritionist]].<ref>[https://www.abc.es/salud/fallece-100-anos-quimica-ana-maria-lajusticia-20241107131839-nt.html Muere a los 100 años la química Ana María Lajusticia, pionera del uso del magnesio como complemento alimenticio] {{in lang|es}}</ref> She died on 7 November 2024, at the age of 100.<ref>{{cite news |title=Muere Ana María Lajusticia, la pionera nutricionista, a los 100 años |url=https://www.elmundo.es/loc/famosos/2024/11/07/672ca8abfc6c8320748b457a.html |access-date=10 November 2024 |publisher=El Mundo |date=7 November 2024}}</ref>
